retrievalProfile.description: A surreal nocturnal scene featuring a figure atop a rustic cabin with dual-layered narrative typography and contrasting light sources.
triggerTerms: man sitting on cabin roof at night

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition centered on a weathered log cabin under a full moon. A shirtless man sits on the roof peak holding a glowing lantern and a book, while a silhouette of a couple appears in a brightly lit window below. Text is integrated both as a weathered painted effect on the roof shingles and as a clean sans-serif overlay at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The lantern light on the roof balances the interior window glow below
The full moon in the upper right creates a diagonal tension with the cabin base
The weathered roof text follows the perspective of the architecture
The dark blue night sky provides a high-contrast backdrop for the warm light points
coreInvariants: Log cabin structure with stone chimney
Full moon in the upper right quadrant
Warm light emanating from a single window and a handheld lantern
Distressed, perspective-aligned text on the roof

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cabin occupies the central and lower-left two-thirds of the frame; the man on the roof acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing lantern held by the man on the roof.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the moon down to the lantern, across the roof text, down to the window silhouette, and finally to the bottom text overlay.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue night sky and dark grassy foreground provide breathing room for the detailed cabin.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and navy blue (nocturnal atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and yellow (lantern and window light)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale grey and white (moonlight and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value/saturation peaks at light sources.
paletteRestrictions: Limit greens to dark, desaturated tones

letterConstructionRules: Roof text must follow the 3D perspective of the shingles
Roof text requires a weathered, stenciled, or painted-on-wood texture
Bottom text is a clean, semi-transparent sans-serif with slight distressing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters on roof are sheared to match the roof pitch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity of style (condensed sans-serif) across different spatial planes.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed profile for the roof text.
Clean, modern condensed sans-serif suitable for the bottom overlay.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a nocturnal scene of a rustic log cabin with a stone chimney. A man sits on the roof peak holding a glowing lantern. A window on the cabin is lit from within showing a silhouette of a couple. A full moon is in the top right sky. The roof shingles should be clear and ready for text mapping.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold condensed sans-serif text to the roof shingles using a perspective warp to match the roof's angle, adding a weathered paint texture. Add a second line of clean, semi-transparent condensed sans-serif text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Text on roof follows the 3D plane of the shingles
Lantern and window are the primary light sources
Moon is positioned in the upper right
Bottom text is centered and legible

adjustableVariables: Weathering level of the roof text
mustRedesign: Ensure the figure on the roof is a generic representation
Change specific wording of the text while maintaining the visual style

mustAchieve: Clear contrast between light sources and dark environment
avoid: Text that looks 'stuck on' without perspective

postGenerationChecks: Does the roof text look like it is painted on the wood?
Is the lantern light casting a believable glow on the figure?
Is the window silhouette sharp and recognizable?
Is the overall color palette cohesive and nocturnal?
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal Cabin + Roof Figure w/ Lantern + Perspective Roof Text + Silhouette Window + Bottom Text Overlay
